name: Hourly Chime
author: kongzong
description: Hourly chime plus one-shot reminders: a Casio-style beep and notification at the top of every hour, and double-beep reminders at user-set times with labels (auto-disabled after firing). Configurable do-not-disturb window (chime only; reminders always fire).

barWidget.description: 整点报时+单次定时提醒,免打扰时段可调
